items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think that's the Jeanette, yeah.

ctx.x: They're both great, but I think I would give the edge to the one with the... One has a team singing on it. A man and a woman, I think.
I think that's the Jeanette, yeah.
And the other one has a girl singing.
